content.label:
This is easy to use and has a good UI. However, it really really needs to integrate with calendar so it can show what’s also due today, otherwise I have to always check due *and* my calendar every time I need to check my schedule. 

Can we get this added? It doesn’t need to be editable, just visible.

Brilliant design and two awesome features (1) The repeating alarms that don't give up until you either  complete the task or reschedule it. (2) The absolute ease of rescheduling.
Very strongly recommended - I use it every day.

title.label: So versatile, for everyday or special reminders

content.label: Have used Due for about three years or more, everything from one-off reminders, daily regular tasks, to regular weekly or less frequent things I have to do.  Even reminders for events years ahead such as certain travel injections ten or more years ahead.  So whether one-off reminders or regular, it works a treat!

I am using the app on my phone and am loving it. However could greatly benefit from  the Mac version (syncing). Just found it but had a question for the developer. The Mac version is quite expensive and the reviews are mixed, was hoping to get a trial before I buy. However as all the others said, no word from the developer. Not a good sign. Where are you???

Simple but hugely effective. Only loses a star because of you have something you need a daily reminder for, your reminders will stop if you have missed a previous day. 

I need to take a pill three times per day and if the morning reminder was not marked as done for Tuesday then the reminder will not alert me on Weds morning and then won’t on Thursday until tues and weds are both marked as done. 

So if you’re super busy you can suddenly slip behind on really important stuff.

title.label: Continues to be my fav reminders app

content.label:
Sleek, smart and most importantly has persistent reminders - completely changed how I go about my day to day life. 

I don’t forget things anymore because it keeps bugging me, either I do them and cross of or postpone by a few minutes.

So I wanted to quickly rate this app. 
It is really good in the fact that it does bug you with the constant notification which you can setup for up to 10 times. In most cases now with my Apple Watch it keep up to date with all my reminders. 
The only issue which might just be me but who know is that the notification sound seems to be lower so you don’t always here it when you away from your phone (without the watch as well). Might just be a setup issue but I cannot find it. 

Overall though, concept of the app works really well. Recommended

Some are moaning about previous versions being better but I find as a new user that is fantastic. I work in a busy retail shop and have at least 10 important jobs to do each shift. This app really works for me. Changing snooze times is great and also the fact it's not a continuous sounding alarm meaning it will sound then go off for a preset reminder also meaning you don't have to physically turn it off. However, since the majority of your alerts are between 1 & 4 seconds it would be better to reduce the snooze time perhaps to sound every 15 seconds, purely because the alerts are so short you could miss them.

Totally recommended. I can’t live without this app! 
Every time I’ve got something in my head to remember to do I add it either on my iPhone or iPad and I’ve synced them so they update together. 
From monthly reminders to do our dogs tablets and recurring ones to change contacts, it’s extremely easy and simple to use. Nice snooze feature and setting recurring reminders is great as you can set them monthly or customise them. 
Can’t imagine a better app for reminders :)

Come back to Due and am not regretting the change back or the new format. Loving it. 
The only improvement I can think of is adding a location reminder departure and arrival, as well as a timely one.
Replaces the terrible stock iOS reminders app and does a great job at doing so.

title.label: The reminder tool for when you just need to be nagged

content.label:
There are a few things in my life that need doing but are in a category of important, but not urgent. The Due app is perfect for these. Daily reminder to take medication? Sure it might not need doing exactly right this instance, but it does need doing. Set up a Due reminder for this and have it give you a nudge every 5 minutes until you’ve done it.

Oh and the timers function is great. Sure the built in iOS timer is handy but sometimes you need to keep track of multiple things at once - this does that, and it does it well
Reminders distilled down to exactly what you need!
The most used app on my iPhone

Don’t be put off by the price. I was furious with the ineptitude displayed by the reminders app on iPhone. Found recommendations for this app. I hesitated a bit because of the price tag, but its absolutely worth every penny if this is something you need.

title.label: Very nice app, with a but

content.label: If you let me sync Outlook with Due, I’ll definitely use it.

title.label: Possibly worst £5 I’ve spent in the App Store

content.label:
I feel guilty writing that headline, but after hearing so many podcasters say this was a must have app, I really fail to see what all the fuss was about.

Notifications don’t happen, or if they do, they do so once or twice before stopping rather than repeating until you set them to “done”. Given that this the core function and USP of the app I feel a bit cheated.

I get more predictable / reliable results just using Apple’s albeit limited stock apps, which I was hoping this would improve on.

Very disappointed.

Update: I tell a lie, just got a notification - over 2 hours after it should’ve been triggered.

title.label: Great app but please fix these two annoyances

content.label:
Amazing app especially the ability to totally customise the menu.

But please can you fix the following:

- If you use the word ‘today’ after midday it sets it to today’s date in a year’s time. This is ridiculous. Other apps would interpret this as today until 11.59pm.

- There needs to be a way to clear logged tasks or opt for them not to show up. I just want them gone.

Would also be nice if you actually replied to support emails given this is a paid app...

I find that Due gives me confidence not to miss things. Even if I’m talking to someone with a phone on my desk, Due can buzz up at the right time to give me my ‘casual’ agenda without needing to touch the phone! Priceless! More importantly I just don’t miss things. Yes there are times are clog your phone up with buzzing, so 5-10 reminders accumulating, but that’s
Just a case of being on top of deleting them the moment you feel the routine is in your memory or is negotiable in importance!
If you need to be regularly reminded to do something that has to be done then this is ideal. I use it to remind me when to take my eye drops, when to put the bins out, take the dogs out etc.
I personally couldn’t do without this app. I have a mind like a sieve so this keeps me on track.
I love it. Haven’t found anything else as good. I use it all the time.
After using many free and paid to do apps this one just works for me. Regular updates and simple app, just what I needed. Cheers!
Zero star!!! This is a pay for app. Why should they ask to pay to get their latest app?? Pathetic

I have used so many todo apps. They all have their strengths. None nag like Due. At first I couldn’t quite imagine how this would help. But Due pesters in the simplest and smartest of ways. Sophisticated and elegant to use. It has transformed my ability to stay focussed. Due is now my trusted todo companion and I feel like we’ll be working together for some time come.

This is one of my favourite apps. I use it all the time.  I concur with other reviewers. What I like best is the fact that the reminders pop up on my lock screen at set intervals until the tasks are completed and I delete them so there is no way I can forget or avoid them. Reminders are easy to set up and can be as easily edited. My efficiency has increased significantly.

The same core features as Due 1 but with a modernised interface; everything here has been carefully considered and it's a pleasure to use.  Integrates well with other apps.

UPDATE v3

This must be the oldest third party app on my phone that’s still in constant use. V3 looks great and brings some nice new snoozing features. This is app that has a small, but perfectly crafted, core feature set - it’s just brilliant.
Ok

title.label: Fast, easy reminder entry and good recurrence / timing options.

content.label:
I’ve tried a number of reminder / task apps and while others do much more, most of the time that extra functionality just gets in the way. 

All I need is something to nudge me to do something, and keep nudging me until I acknowledge it. 

Due is perfect for this. Creating a reminder is quick and simple, and then it gets out of the way. Great!
I use it every single day. It is concise, detailed yet simple....just what I need for my daily (and weekly, monthly, recurring etc) reminders! Thank you Due! 👍🤗
Want to be nagged about important tasks, this is the app. It's so simple yet so good, it's actually invaluable
The ONLY way to ensure that you never forget to do something. Keeps reminding you until you clear it. Wonderful.

title.label: Stopped working on watch after update

content.label: All was great but stopped working in my watch after update - please sort

What Due does superbly is remind you about things and then let you delay them so it (helpfully) nags you an hour later, a day later or whatever. It’s also great for repeated reminders (daily, weekly etc.)

It’s especially great if you use Apple Watch, where it gives you simple, great options that are super-quick to use. I actually much prefer the Watch interface for delaying reminders to the one on the phone.

The one thing I have never found Due does well is syncing between and iPad and Phone. In particular, clearing a notification on the phone rarely seemed to clear it on the iPad, or vice verse, whether syncing through iCloud or Dropbox. I’ve been much happier since deleting it from the iPad and just using the Watch and iPhone combination.

I love this App, it is definitely the most useful & most used App on my phone.  I need to bring order to the chaos of my modern life, which is often characterised by poor time-management skills & a desperate attempt to juggle everything... this is the solution!

I am hugely grateful for any App that can help me manage my life better, & also love being able to customise just about every conceivable setting to get the results you need.  This is a definite improvement over the default Apple reminder offering & also beats the competition hands down!

The App has received some great updates & features, so I’m encouraged that it will be well maintained.  I’d love to see an update add a feature to optionally colour-code entries in your list; the addition of a translucent background colour could serve to categorise reminders without the need to navigate separate lists.

Definitely the best!

Use this multiple times a day, every day. Repeatedly saves me from missed meetings, parking tickets, forgotten train tickets, etc.  The addition of background sync was the final piece of the jigsaw, for me anyway. Well maintained too...

I’ve had Due for years - it is so easy to use and has really great features
Lovely updated UI and iOS features.
Well done!

Lots of apps try and be clever and force you down their perceived way of organising reminders, whereas Due has kept it simple, allowing the user to do so in a simple, reliable interface that is quick to use and can be counted on to alert. 
I use Due all day every day for routine and important reminders and I can’t recommend it enough.
I use Due for my daily routines and it is great. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a mini task manager or for persistent reminders! Well worth it

title.label: This is my most used app on iOS

content.label: For many it’ll be the music app, iMessages or maybe even the telephone app but for me my № 1 app is Due. I use it multiple times a day. I love the easy to use and clean interface and how I will keep being reminded to do something until I mark it complete. The new dark theme is great too. I wouldn’t be without this app. 5 ⭐️

I have a bunch of todo style apps that I use regularly, but Due is the one I use daily. It keeps me on top of my work and my life (medication reminders, and such). It is easy, obvious and a pleasure to use. Without it I probably couldn’t function as a human being any more.
Fantastic app. Used it every day for years. Only improvement I’d like is the ability to suspend repeating appointments. Would be good for times you are out of routine such as holidays.
People think I’m one incredibly well organised, really I just save everything in Due. Got my life so organised, I have tasks scheduled down to 10 minute slots.
Be Best

title.label: How on earth did I survive without Due?!

content.label:
Long story short: I love this app.

I’m in the kind of business where people come at me from all angles asking me to do stuff, chase things up, call people back, complete small tasks, and up until now these things just went in one ear, and out the other.

It took a good few weeks of practise but I’m now in the habit of adding absolutely anything I get asked to do, no matter how small, to my list in Due, and setting a deadline.  If I don’t do it, I snooze it until I do, but either way my full task list is always there, and I no longer forget about stuff.

Absolute life saver!!

title.label: The most used app on my phone.

content.label: I literally could not survive without this app. I’ve used it day in day out for years. Looking forward to using the 3.0 update!

title.label: What the iOS Reminders app should have been.

content.label: I’ve been using Due for 5 years and it just keeps getting better.
Great power reminders app. Use it every single day!
Excellent app, easy to use and very useful for everyday tasks. One thing that would be nice to add is a Widget for notification screen.

Wish it would also connect with other reminder apps otherwise love it.  Even better when connected to the Apple Watch as you can delay or mark done without opening your phone. 

6 Stars
